name: agent-config-mcp
label: Agent Self-Config
description: Lets an agent mark post-install setup complete, and inspect and modify its own settings: its persona (config/agent.md), identity (display name, description, color), default model, default execution layer, default scope and per-agent memory toggles. Platform admins/creators additionally get self-scope company wiring. They share this agent's knowledge folder as a shared knowledge library, attach/detach other agents' libraries, and assign the agent to a department. Each such call requires in-chat approval. Managers also limit what the agent may use of each MCP (get_tool_limits, set_tool_limits). Every person's chat also gets the two tools of its own session, reload_session and switch_account. The first rebuilds this chat's session after a tool was enabled or an account connected. The second moves this chat to another account of one tool. Permission-aware: below the editor tier a session sees complete_setup and those two only.

skills.description: When to reload this chat's session or switch its account
